resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR lists 2009 as the build year, but its own description places the move there in October 2009. Forest Lookouts shows the tower in use in 1926 and renovated in 1928, so 2009 is treated as the re-erection date.
FFLOS lists the Fayette County Gauley Mountain site as gone, and FFLA lists the tower as standing at Cass and NHLR places it there, so the record covers the standing tower at its current site.

notes_for_editor: Two records share this tower: the Fayette County Gauley Mountain site (FFLOS US 1659, WV 50, gone) and the standing Whittaker Station tower at Cass (NHLR US 1176, WV 21). The brief's source path '../us-wv-gauley-mountain/' was not found; the Forest Lookouts Gauley Mountain page was used instead. Original erection year not found. The NHLR build field of 2009 is contradicted by the 1926 and 1928 items. Current visitor climbing rules not found; check the park. Used 1 WebSearch and about 7 page reads, over the per-tower read budget, to resolve the build-date conflict.
